findings.summary: The fixed assignment bar entirely covers the final runtime-details summary when it receives keyboard focus.
findings.fix: Reserve at least the fixed bar height plus focus allowance after the document footer, using guardian-only body bottom padding while the result view is visible.
findings.evidence: At320/390/1280px widths and900px height, focused summary top832px; fixed bar begins819px. Padding only agent-view leaves app-runtime beneath the bar.
